publications.name: Optimal Driving between Nonequilibrium Steady States under a Dissipation Budget
publications.summary: We study optimal driving between nonequilibrium steady states under a fixed housekeeping dissipation budget, deriving geometric bounds on total entropy production and illustrating them with an ATP-driven calcium pump model.

publications.name: Information geometry of perturbed gradient flow systems on hypergraphs: A perspective towards nonequilibrium physics
publications.summary: This article reviews the connection between gradient flow systems on hypergraphs and information geometry, including thermodynamic uncertainty relations, speed limits, and entropy production decompositions.

publications.name: Transitions and thermodynamics on species graphs of chemical reaction networks
publications.summary: This paper proposes a method to coarse-grain reaction systems and represent them as a graph structure. This method expresses the system as a graph by focusing on the conserved quantities of the system and discusses the related thermodynamic quantities and their interrelationships.
